question: ‘Chapchar Kut’ is a festival from the state of _________. It is celebrated during March after the completion of the most arduous task of Jhum operation i.e., jungle clearing (clearing of the remnants of burning).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chapchar Kut** is a traditional festival celebrated in the state of **Mizoram**.
 
• It is observed during the month of **March** after the completion of the most arduous task of Jhum operation, which involves **jungle clearing** (removal of remnants of burning).
 
• The festival is marked by vibrant cultural activities, including traditional dances, songs, and feasts.
 
• Chapchar Kut is one of the most significant and colorful festivals in Mizoram, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of the Mizo people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mizoram is one of the northeastern states of India, known for its picturesque landscapes and vibrant culture.
 
• The Mizo people, who are the predominant ethnic group in Mizoram, have a rich tradition of festivals and cultural practices.
 
• Other major festivals celebrated in Mizoram include **Thalfavang Kut** and **Pawl Kut**.
 
• The state of Mizoram was granted statehood on **20th February 1987**.
